title: Cherry pick the other jtckdint changes onto 4.4
description: In order to make it easier to backport fixes for the deluge of various recent reports (often AI-generated), backport some of the changes to ship jtckdint.h and include it in wireshark.h by default.

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
